question: Should this Zalo sanitizer PR wait for redacted live Zalo delivery proof, or may maintainers override the proof gate based on focused tests and sibling-channel precedent?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but external PR policy requires real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally accepts the remaining delivery uncertainty.

options.title: Require Live Zalo Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Zalo transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing the trace line stripped and ordinary text preserved before merge.

options.title: Override The Proof Gate
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally merge on the small diff, focused tests, and sibling-channel precedent while accepting that live Zalo delivery was not observed.

options.title: Pause For Shared Default
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the remaining sanitizer work replaced by one shared outbound sanitizer default instead of per-channel hooks.

recommendation.title: Require Live Zalo Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Zalo transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing the trace line stripped and ordinary text preserved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest recent history on both the Zalo adapter and shared outbound delivery hook lines involved in the proof-risk decision.
